pages.title: Tautology Shard
pages.text: A sliver of a statement true in every case there is: "it rains or it does not". Found in Tautology Ore in the Axioms, the Platonic Realm's lowest layer (Y −720 to −650), and dropped by Paradox Shades. The Formal Proof Assistant writes Proof Certificates and Axiom Schemas from it.

$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Tautology Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Paradox Shade.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Liars Vault, Proof Stairs chests.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Axiom Schema, Postulate Slate, Proof Certificate, Proof Fragment.
